implementation.targetScope: RovingFocusGroup/Item, scope factory, controlled/uncontrolled tab stops, pointer/keyboard entry, orientation/RTL/looping, hydration, render-prop children, slots and current Dropdown Menu callers on React 19.

changes: Use VPM foundations throughout, including linear collection ordering.
Own queued navigation per group, cancel on unmount, read current items at delivery and do not steal focus after a later interaction.
Compare focus in the element owner document and dispatch entry events in its window.
Keep nonfocusable current items out of the tab sequence; refresh entry listeners when a slotted root changes.
